name: The Crimson Debt
source:
You've lived your whole life in a single basement. Now, your cage is unlocked. You could leave this house at any moment you want. But without knowing what happened, can you ever truly be free? 

[From [url=https://themis729.itch.io/the-crimson-debt]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你这一生都活在同一间地下室里。如今，囚禁你的牢笼已经打开，你随时都可以离开这栋房子。可若是不查明究竟发生了什么，你真能获得真正的自由吗？

[摘自[url=https://themis729.itch.io/the-crimson-debt]itch.io[/url]]
